d.why: On screen only in a flashback in 'Doctor Strange' (S3E1), where he teaches Stephen Strange, defeats Baron Mordo and takes Strange as his pupil; kept as the master and leader of Doctor Strange, the title character of that episode.
On screen in four Season 5 episodes (Secret Wars ch.1 and 3, and the Spider-Wars two-parter), where he tests Spider-Man and leads him to the Spider-Men.
Only in 'Unclaimed Legacy' (S5E3), where this Moscow policeman and old friend of Robbie gives him Illyena's address, a helper with a few lines in Peter's search.
On screen in both parts of the Mutant Agenda / Mutants' Revenge two-parter (S2E4-5).

Only in 'The Lizard King' (S4E10), where she is one of the three lizard warriors whose kidnapping of Curt Connors is the episode's plot, then refuses to let Spider-Man be destroyed and is locked up with him.
On screen as the Bugle's secretary in S1E13 and 'Guilty' (S4E1), with a phone call in S4E3.
Only in 'Farewell, Spider-Man' (S5E13), where she is Spider-Carnage's hostage; kept as the fiancee of the Armored Spider-Man, who is on screen in two episodes.
Only in 'The Prowler' (S4E11), where he is the crime boss who orders Hobie killed and whom the Prowler defeats: the episode's antagonist and Hobie's boss.
On screen only in 'Unclaimed Legacy' (S5E3), showing Peter and Robbie her father's evidence; kept as the daughter of Wolfgang Groitzig, who is in several Six Forgotten Warriors episodes.
Only in 'Rocket Racer' (S3E5), where as the Big Wheel he leads the jet-pack gang and is the episode's villain.
Only in 'Guilty' (S4E1), where this old contact briefly straps Jameson into a chair before Jameson gets the tip he needs, a minor figure in the Robbie subplot.
On screen in three Season 1 episodes (S1E7-9), the Alien Costume story.
On screen only in 'Spot' (S3E12) and mentioned in S3E13-14; he is that episode's title villain, the Spot.
On screen in four Six Forgotten Warriors episodes (S5E2, S5E4-6).
Only in 'Goblin War!' (S3E13), where he tries to pawn the accelerator, sets it off and is pulled clear by Spider-Man, a bystander before the Hobgoblin story.
On screen in about seven episodes from Season 2 to the Season 5 wedding.
On screen in the two Punisher episodes (S2E7-8) and in S4E8.
Only in 'Make a Wish' (S4E9), where as Mysterio's cyborg partner she captures Mary Jane to steal her body: the episode's antagonist.
Only in 'The Lizard King' (S4E10), where he leads the lizard warriors who kidnap Connors to take over the world: the episode's villain.
Only in 'Attack of the Octobot' (S3E3), where this cab driver helps Taina find the brainwashed Spider-Man and rallies her fellow drivers, a helper in Taina's story.
Only in 'Rocket Racer' (S3E5); kept as the mother of Robert Farrell, the title character who drives that episode.
On screen in 'Guilty' (S4E1) and 'The Awakening' (S4E6), with his byline named in several earlier episodes.
On screen in four Six Forgotten Warriors episodes (S5E2, S5E4-6) as the Black Marvel.
Only in 'The Prowler' (S4E11), the episode about him: he becomes the Prowler, is trapped by the Kingpin's suit and quits crime.
On screen in 'Tombstone' (S3E9), the episode about him joining Tombstone's gang and being set up (with a flashback in S4E1); he is also Robbie Robertson's son.
Only in 'Rocket Racer' (S3E5), the episode about him: he robs a jeweler with stolen jet tech, then helps stop the Big Wheel.
On screen only in 'Partners' (S4E5), where she frees the Vulture to save the Scorpion; kept as the Scorpion's fiancee.
